explanation: A prophet in the Old Testament who proclaimed God's message to the people of Israel.
Another name for God, used to show respect and reverence.
The name of God's chosen people, also a geographical area in the Middle East.
Patriarch of the twelve tribes of Israel, son of Isaac and grandson of Abraham.
A person who serves and obeys God; in this context it refers to Israel as God's servant.
To buy back or set free; here it means that God will deliver his people from their sins and suffering.
Symbolizes life and blessing, often used to describe God's grace and care.
Refers to the Spirit of God, a divine power that gives life, wisdom, and guidance.
The belief that God will act for the good of his people and restore their relationship with him.
False gods or idols that people worship instead of the true God.
